hint.quota_ok: Quota: the year’s actual and the three-year mean per combination are within the target of the planning approval.
hint.quota_warn: Quota: actual or three-year mean above the target, but at most 125 %.
hint.quota_over: Quota: actual or three-year mean above 125 % of the target.
hint.quota_none: Quota: no light, the basis is missing.
hint.noise_ok: Noise: every immission point of the current state meets the limits with reserve.
hint.noise_warn: Noise: at least one immission point is less than 5 dB below the limit.
hint.noise_over: Noise: at least one immission point exceeds the limit.
hint.noise_none: Noise: no light, the basis is missing.
hint.noise_incomplete: Noise: not assessable – usages without a source or level in the state (rule O8); partial levels visible in the details.
hint.no_calculation: No calculation state is marked as «current».
hint.no_usages: No usages recorded in the year and the two years before. No entries does not mean zero shots.
hint.no_quota: At least one shot combination has no quota: target 0, every shot counts as an exceedance (B1 5.10).
